title: A finite triangular covariant hierarchy has no charge--spatial top corner

triangular_hierarchy.matter_energy: Sum over T_R of ||D_t D^alpha Q^n phi||_2^2+||D_x D^alpha Q^n phi||_2^2+m^2||D^alpha Q^n phi||_2^2+mu||Q D^alpha Q^n phi||_2^2
triangular_hierarchy.principal_tier: For every (alpha,n) in T_R the energy controls one additional covariant derivative or one additional Q, hence every matter factor of combined order <=R+1
triangular_hierarchy.commutator_closure: K1386 places every curvature commutator factor D^gamma Q^(n+1)phi in the same principal tier because |gamma|+n+1<=|alpha|+n+1<=R+1
triangular_hierarchy.radial_closure: Q commutes with the real radial multiplier; spatially commuted polynomial radial terms obey the ordinary H^R tame product estimate for R>=3
triangular_hierarchy.comparison: K1384's finite-p rectangle advances both independent ceilings to (S+3/p,N+1); T_R instead pays a curvature commutator by exchanging derivative and charge position at fixed combined order
triangular_hierarchy.boundary: This removes the algebraic top-corner loss for a finite high-regularity hierarchy; it does not by itself bound the Maxwell coefficients globally or prove existence
